Make it interactive · slower
Ask one of these, then tap 🧩 under the answer.
What are the three highest mountains, and how tall is each?
How do you purify water in the wild, step by step?

Under any answer, open 🧩. The model that answered picks what fits (a bar, line or pie chart, a table, steps, a comparison or key facts) and BOAR draws it. Numbers from earlier answers in the chat can join in. Switch between bars, line, pie and table, copy it, or open it full screen.

Make it interactive (under a visual) builds a small page, like a converter or a quiz. It is slower, and small models often get it wrong.

A visual uses only what the answer says: a number or name that isn't there is thrown away. Interactive pages run locked: no internet, no files, no access to BOAR or your chats. Nothing for health or seed-phrase questions. The idea comes from CopilotKit's Open Intelligent UI (MIT); here it runs on your phone with no server.
